original_benchmark.notes: Blender, Mantaflow, libuipc, PPF and MPM scenes with released reference 4D worlds. The upstream agent image installs the Claude Code and Codex CLIs from npm without a version pin.
Real videos without a reference 4D world; 23 of the 100 clips are not redistributed and are rebuilt from their public sources by the dataset's prepare_videos.py.

harbor_adapter.notes: Oracle submits the published reference world with a placeholder solution/build.sh. Run on a GPU on all 100 synthetic cases: every reading matched the original scorer exactly on every case. 94 pass both gates; the 6 liquid-only worlds without dynamics/ (B_09, B_11, B_13, B_14, B_19, B_28) fail the original scorer's own world gate; on G_02 and S_02 some metrics are error on both sides under the upstream 32 GiB scorer memory limit. The ceiling is below 1.0 on some metrics for most cases (README, Notes & Caveats). Parity not yet run.
Oracle unresolved: the benchmark has no reference 4D world for real cases. Parity not yet run.
